refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Login is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# APIs for managing login sessions. interface io.systemd.Login
# Various types of sessions type SessionType( unspecified, tty, x11, wayland, mir, web )
# Various classes of sessions type SessionClass( # Regular user sessions user, # Session of the root user that shall be open for login from earliest moment on, and not be delayed for /run/nologin user_early, # Regular user session whose home directory is not available right now, but will be later, at which point the session class can be upgraded to 'user' user_incomplete, # A user session that doesn't pull in the per-user service manager user_light, # The combination of user_early and user_light user_early_light, # Display manager greeter screen used for login greeter, # Similar, but a lock screen lock_screen, # Background session (that has no TTY, VT, Seat) background, # Similar, but for which no service manager is invoked background_light, # The special session of the service manager manager, # The special session of the service manager for the root user manager_early )
# Inhibition mode type InhibitMode( # Hard inhibition; blocks the operation entirely block, # Weak hard inhibition; like block, but the user who set it can override it without polkit authorization block_weak, # Soft inhibition; delays the operation but ultimately permits it delay )
# Operations that can be inhibited type InhibitWhat( shutdown, sleep, idle, handle_power_key, handle_suspend_key, handle_hibernate_key, handle_lid_switch, handle_reboot_key )
# Process identifier type ProcessId( # Numeric UNIX PID value pid: int, # 64bit inode number of pidfd if known pidfdId: ?int, # Boot ID of the system the inode number belongs to bootId: ?string )
# Dual timestamp type Timestamp( # Timestamp in µs in the CLOCK_REALTIME clock (wallclock) realtime: ?int, # Timestamp in µs in the CLOCK_MONOTONIC clock monotonic: ?int )
# Configuration aspects of a session (suitable for reuse as creation input) type SessionContext( # Numeric UNIX UID of the user owning this session UID: int, # PID of the session leader PID: ?ProcessId, # The type of the session Type: SessionType, # The class of the session Class: SessionClass, # PAM service name Service: ?string, # Desktop identifier Desktop: ?string, # Seat this session is assigned to Seat: ?string, # Virtual terminal number of the session, if applicable VTNr: ?int, # TTY device of the session TTY: ?string, # X11 display of the session Display: ?string, # Whether this is a remote session Remote: ?bool, # Remote host, if this is a remote session RemoteHost: ?string, # Remote user, if this is a remote session RemoteUser: ?string, # Device paths this session has special access to ExtraDeviceAccess: ?[]string )
# Runtime state and dynamic information of a session type SessionRuntime( # The session identifier Id: string, # systemd scope unit name Scope: ?string, # Audit session ID Audit: ?int, # The session timestamps Timestamp: ?Timestamp, # Current state of the session State: string, # Whether the session is active (i.e. in the foreground) Active: bool, # Whether the session is idle IdleHint: bool, # Timestamp when the session went idle, only present when IdleHint is true IdleSinceHint: ?Timestamp, # Whether the session is currently locked LockedHint: bool, # Whether this session class supports idle tracking CanIdle: bool, # Whether this session class supports locking CanLock: bool )
# Configuration aspects of a user type UserContext( # Numeric UNIX UID UID: int, # Numeric UNIX GID GID: int, # User name Name: string, # Whether lingering is enabled for this user Linger: bool, # Service manager unit name Service: ?string, # User slice unit name Slice: ?string, # Path to the user's runtime directory RuntimePath: ?string )
# Runtime state and dynamic information of a user type UserRuntime( # Display session identifier Display: ?string, # Current state of the user State: ?string, # Identifiers of sessions belonging to this user Sessions: ?[]string, # Timestamp when the user was 'started' for the first time Timestamp: ?Timestamp, # Whether the user is idle IdleHint: bool, # Timestamp when the user went idle, only present when IdleHint is true IdleSinceHint: ?Timestamp )
# Configuration aspects of a seat type SeatContext( # The seat identifier Id: string )
# Runtime state and dynamic information of a seat type SeatRuntime( # The currently active session on this seat, if any ActiveSession: ?string, # Identifiers of sessions assigned to this seat Sessions: ?[]string, # Whether this seat supports text terminal sessions CanTTY: bool, # Whether this seat supports graphical sessions CanGraphical: bool, # Whether the seat is idle IdleHint: bool, # Timestamp when the seat went idle, only present when IdleHint is true IdleSinceHint: ?Timestamp )
# Configuration aspects of an inhibitor type InhibitorContext( # The inhibitor identifier Id: string, # What is being inhibited What: []InhibitWhat, # A human-readable descriptive string of who is taking the inhibition Who: ?string, # A human-readable descriptive string of why the inhibition is taken Why: ?string, # The inhibition mode Mode: InhibitMode, # The UID of the user taking the inhibition UID: int )
# Runtime state and dynamic information of an inhibitor type InhibitorRuntime( # The PID of the process taking the inhibition PID: ?ProcessId, # The inhibitor timestamps Since: ?Timestamp )
# Allocates a new session. method CreateSession( # Numeric UNIX UID of the user owning this session UID: int, # PID of the session leader PID: ?ProcessId, # The type of the session Type: SessionType, # The class of the session Class: SessionClass, # PAM service name Service: ?string, # Desktop identifier Desktop: ?string, # Seat this session is assigned to Seat: ?string, # Virtual terminal number of the session, if applicable VTNr: ?int, # TTY device of the session TTY: ?string, # X11 display of the session Display: ?string, # Whether this is a remote session Remote: ?bool, # Remote host, if this is a remote session RemoteHost: ?string, # Remote user, if this is a remote session RemoteUser: ?string, # Device paths this session has special access to ExtraDeviceAccess: ?[]string ) -> ( # The identifier string of the session of the user. Id: string, # The runtime path ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR) of the user. RuntimePath: string, # The original UID of this session. UID: int, # The seat this session has been assigned to Seat: ?string, # The virtual terminal number the session has been assigned to VTNr: ?int, # The assigned session type Type: SessionType, # The assigned session class Class: SessionClass )
# Releases an existing session. Currently, will be refused unless originating from the session to release itself. method ReleaseSession( # The identifier string of the session to release. If unspecified or 'self', will return the callers session. Id: ?string ) -> ()
# Lists current sessions. If an Id or PID filter is provided, returns the single matching session; otherwise streams all current sessions (requires the 'more' flag). # [Supports 'more' flag] method ListSessions( # If non-null, the identifier string of a session to look up. Supports the special names 'self' and 'auto' which resolve to the caller's session. Id: ?string, # If non-null, return the session containing the process with this PID. If both Id and PID are specified they must reference the same session, otherwise NoSuchSession is returned. PID: ?ProcessId ) -> ( # Configuration of the session context: SessionContext, # Runtime information of the session runtime: SessionRuntime )
# Lists current users. If a UID or PID filter is provided, returns the single matching user; otherwise streams all current users (requires the 'more' flag). # [Supports 'more' flag] method ListUsers( # If non-null, the UNIX UID of a user to look up. UID: ?int, # If non-null, return the user owning the cgroup containing the process with this PID. If both UID and PID are specified they must reference the same user, otherwise NoSuchUser is returned. PID: ?ProcessId ) -> ( # Configuration of the user context: UserContext, # Runtime information of the user runtime: UserRuntime )
# Lists current seats. If an Id filter is provided, returns the single matching seat; otherwise streams all current seats (requires the 'more' flag). # [Supports 'more' flag] method ListSeats( # If non-null, the identifier string of a seat to look up. Id: ?string ) -> ( # Configuration of the seat context: SeatContext, # Runtime information of the seat runtime: SeatRuntime )
# Lists all current inhibitors. # [Requires 'more' flag] method ListInhibitors() -> ( # Configuration of the inhibitor context: InhibitorContext, # Runtime information of the inhibitor runtime: InhibitorRuntime )
# No session by this name found error NoSuchSession()
# No seat by this name found error NoSuchSeat()
# No user by this UID found error NoSuchUser()
# No inhibitor found error NoSuchInhibitor()
# Process already member of a session error AlreadySessionMember()
# The specified virtual terminal (VT) is already taken by another session error VirtualTerminalAlreadyTaken()
# Maximum number of sessions reached error TooManySessions()
# Failed to allocate a unit for the session error UnitAllocationFailed()
# The session leader process does not have a pidfd error NoSessionPIDFD()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Login shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Login.CreateSession '{}' invokes its CreateSession() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Login interface was added in version >= 0.60.0.

AlreadySessionMember, CreateSession(), InhibitMode, InhibitWhat, InhibitorContext, InhibitorRuntime, ListInhibitors(), ListSeats(), ListSessions(), ListUsers(), NoSessionPIDFD, NoSuchInhibitor, NoSuchSeat, NoSuchSession, NoSuchUser, ProcessId, ReleaseSession(), SeatContext, SeatRuntime, SessionClass, SessionContext, SessionRuntime, SessionType, Timestamp, TooManySessions, UnitAllocationFailed, UserContext, UserRuntime, and VirtualTerminalAlreadyTaken were added in version >= 0.60.0.
